title: Scor confirms ANZ leadership role
full_text:
Scor confirms ANZ leadership role
Global reinsurer Scor has appointed Adrian Kerins as permanent head of life and health for Australia and New Zealand after three months as interim.
“Since joining Scor in April 2025 as head of strategy and growth for ANZ, Adrian has played a key role in shaping the business’ strategic direction and strengthening engagement with clients and partners across the region,” the company said.
“As interim head of ANZ since August, he has successfully led the organisation through a period of transition while maintaining strong momentum across the market and continuing to deliver for clients.”
Mr Kerins says he is “thrilled” to take on the role permanently.
“ANZ is a key market for Scor with significant developments and activity occurring across ... traditional protection, longevity, financial and digital reinsurance solutions,” he said.
“I’m fortunate to take on the leadership of a strong local team which has developed great relationships with clients across both Australia and New Zealand over the past decade and I look forward to deepening and extending those further.”
Mr Kerins has more than 20 years’ experience across the insurance and reinsurance industries, including senior leadership, strategy and technical roles.
He was previously at Munich Re, AIA and CommInsure.
